## **Patient, tumour and sample characteristics** {#clin-info}

This section summarises the basic clinical and sample metadata for the case.
If `params$patient_csv` is provided, the values in that file are used to fill
the table below. Any missing field, empty value, or unavailable file is shown
as `UNKNOWN`.

```{r patient_info_setup, include=FALSE}
library(htmltools)
library(reactable)
library(purrr)
patient_fields <- c(
  "Hospital",
  "Patient number",
  "Date of birth",
  "Tissue ID",
  "Date of sampling",
  "Sampling anatomical site",
  "Sample type",
  "Histological cancer type",
  "Tumour cell content",
  "Sample ID(s)",
  "Matched normal DNA",
  "Source of normal"
)

patient_summary_template <- dplyr::tibble(
  variable = patient_fields,
  value = rep("UNKNOWN", length(patient_fields))
)

read_patient_info <- function(path) {
  if (is.null(path) || !nzchar(path) || !file.exists(path)) {
    return(patient_summary_template)
  }

  patient_raw <- readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE)

  if (nrow(patient_raw) == 0L || ncol(patient_raw) < 2L) {
    return(patient_summary_template)
  }

  if (all(c("variable", "value") %in% names(patient_raw))) {
    patient_kv <- patient_raw |>
      dplyr::select(variable, value)
  } else if (all(c("field", "value") %in% names(patient_raw))) {
    patient_kv <- patient_raw |>
      dplyr::transmute(variable = field, value = value)
  } else {
    patient_kv <- patient_raw |>
      dplyr::select(1, 2) |>
      rlang::set_names(c("variable", "value"))
  }

  patient_kv <- patient_kv |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      variable = trimws(as.character(variable)),
      value = trimws(as.character(value))
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(variable), variable != "")

  lookup <- patient_kv |>
    dplyr::distinct(variable, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
    tibble::deframe()

  patient_summary_template |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      value = dplyr::coalesce(unname(lookup[variable]), value),
      value = dplyr::if_else(is.na(value) | !nzchar(value), "UNKNOWN", value)
    )
}

pt_summary <- read_patient_info(params$patient_csv)

summary_cards <- div(
  style = "
    width: 90%;
    margin: 20px auto;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr));
    gap: 10px;
  ",
  purrr::pmap(
    pt_summary,
    function(variable, value, ...) {
      div(
        style = "
          display: flex;
          flex-direction: column;
          border-radius: 10px;
          overflow: hidden;
          background: white;
          border: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
        ",
        
        div(
          style = "
            background: #1e3a8a;
            color: white;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;
            padding: 4px 6px;
            text-align: center;
          ",
          variable
        ),
        
        div(
          style = "
            padding: 10px 8px;
            text-align: center;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: #0f172a;
          ",
          value
        )
      )
    }
  )
)
```

```{r patient_info_table, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
summary_cards
```
